description: Ground floor rear/ side infill extension and associated works
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Within a month of the first occupation of the development, one native-species tree will be planted on site to provide a biodiversity uplift and evidence of planting must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Alongside evidence of planting, the following details must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority:Soil volumes for tree planting;Methods of tree support e.g. staking, underground guying and protection;Management and maintenance tasks.The tree shall be maintained for 5 years after planting and should it be removed, die, be severely damaged or become seriously diseased within this period it shall be replaced with another tree as originally required to be planted by this condition. The tree shall be retained thereafter for the lifetime of the development in accordance with the approved management and maintenance tasks. REASON: To ensure that the site protects and enhances biodiversity, in accordance with LP47 of the Hackney Local Plan.

Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management and maintenance plan (where applicable) for the proposed permeable paving shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with the LLFA. Where infiltration is proposed, an infiltration test shall be carried out in accordance with BRE Digest 365 and all designs shall be based on the actual infiltration rates obtained. Infiltration units must demonstrate half-emptying of the provided storage within 24 hours for up to the 1 in 10 year return period storm across all rainfall durations. It must also be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged off-site and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.REASON: To mitigate against the impacts of surface water flooding.

<p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture notwithstanding the details within the approved plans.&nbsp;</p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-cc69126f-7fff-ea01-32fa-2db381ed48be"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</span></span></p>
